story:
Firefly Contractors & Design is a locally owned, family-run remodeling company based in Otis Orchards, Washington. For 15 years we've helped Spokane-area homeowners protect and reinvent their homes — from full roof replacements and new siding to complete kitchen and bathroom remodels. Every project is run by a licensed, insured, and bonded team that treats your home like our own.

We built this company on straight talk, clean job sites, and craftsmanship you can point at years later. Whether you need storm-damaged shingles replaced or you're ready to reimagine the way your kitchen lives, Firefly delivers thoughtful design paired with skilled trades — all backed by a written workmanship warranty and a name your neighbors know.
